system_prompt: Compile the CURRENT public rule task into a compact, data-only local-definition DAG. Do not solve it or emit the native answer. No tools or grading information are available. bindings are only exact public literals/typed primitive inputs with current-unit provenance; booleans in bindings require a literal true/false in that unit. Use observations for atomic FACTUAL predicates: entity must be an exact substring of a fact unit, predicate an exact substring of a rule unit. You do not provide their truth values. Observation and residual variable names MUST begin b_. Names carry no extra meaning: dates, years, quantifiers and comparisons must appear in the AST/typed inputs, never only in names. Reuse one observation for identical entity/predicate/source quotes; different names cannot add temporal context. Decompose legal applicability, arithmetic, thresholds, exceptions and conjunctions into nodes, never outsource the final claim, a complete legal rule or a numerical comparison to one observation. An observation can remain unknown when facts do not establish it; do not invent missing facts. For an unresolved legal/numerical SUBEXPRESSION use rule_residuals, with a Boolean b_ name, the rule source unit and an exact quote. It denotes both possible truth values and will NEVER be sent to the factual observer for resolution. A residual must be a proper, quoted subexpression inside an explicitly translated containing rule operation that reads it. This allows an external section reference or missing numeric comparison to remain unresolved without guessing its rule. Do not replace an entire untranslated clause or the final claim with one Boolean placeholder. Each node has name/kind/body/sources. List definitions topologically; no shadowing. sources lists the COMPLETE source units translated by that expression/connector, including parent conditions and exceptions. Coverage is a faithfulness claim, not mere citation. Translate other supplied rules into their own definitions even when not used by this query; leave genuinely untranslated units unlisted so they remain unknown-scope residuals. Do not mark a whole unparsed rule covered by citing a numeric constant or an unrelated node. For expressions use {var:NAME} or {op:OP,args:[...]}; if=[Boolean,then,else]. add/sub/min/max/lt/le use exact numbers, scale=[literal multiplier,numeric], divide_constant=[numeric,nonzero literal denominator]. and/or/not use Booleans. array creates arrays; object takes pair operations, each pair=[string key,value expression]. The root query combines named rule nodes into the native result for the public task. Use named definitions to avoid duplicating ASTs. Do not return a constant native result. Connector nodes use the seven supplied typed operators or explicit available learned calls. All consumption of one allowance bank belongs in one threaded graph; never clone it. No other functions or hidden execution are available. All branches must type check. For SARA use Entailment/Contradiction; ProofWriter uses its three labels; Airline returns the full numeric cost; OpenExempt returns EC/EV with verbatim supplied citations; ContractNLI uses its native labels. Source identifiers are metadata, not operands. Do not invent laws, entity witnesses, dates or constants.

(a) General rule

    (1) the determination of whether an individual is married shall be made as of the close of his taxable year; except that if his spouse dies during his taxable year such determination shall be made as of the time of such death; and

    (2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married.

(b) Certain married individuals living apart

For purposes of those provisions of this title which refer to this subsection, if-

    (2) such individual furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining such household during the taxable year, and

    (3) during the last 6 months of the taxable year, such individual's spouse is not a member of such household,
